description: This file contains functions for fetching module overview data, metrics, and derived modules from various API endpoints in a frontend application. It includes logic for resolving base URLs, making authenticated fetch requests, and processing responses to provide data for a dashboard.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches modules or overview data for the authenticated user/tenant, attempting multiple endpoints and deriving lightweight modules if primary data is unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total users and deployed applications metrics for the dashboard overview.
